title: Email Accounts
subtitle: Postfix/Dovecot-based mailboxes. Can be used for authenticated sending (SMTP 587, STARTTLS) in your applications (PHPMailer etc.).

enable.success: Email was enabled for this domain. MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC records were added to the DNS section.
enable.not_enabled: Email is not yet enabled for this domain.
enable.hint: Once enabled, MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC records are added to DNS automatically.

newPassword.title: ✓ Password for {{email}}
newPassword.hint: Save this somewhere safe, it won't be shown again:

mailbox.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the mailbox "{{email}}"? (Maildir stays on disk, only the account is removed.)

forwarders.title: Forwarders & Catch-All
forwarders.desc: Forwards incoming mail to other address(es) without creating a mailbox. If "Forward all mail for this domain" is selected, mail to any address without a defined mailbox goes to this destination (catch-all).
forwarders.catch_all_label: Forward all mail for this domain (catch-all)
forwarders.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the forwarder "{{source}}"?

spam.title: Rspamd Spam Protection
spam.desc: Domain policy applied to incoming mail based on SPF, DKIM, content, reputation and the learned Bayes score.
spam.enable_label: Enable spam filtering for this domain
spam.add_header_help: Delivers the message, marks it as spam
spam.reject_help: Refuses the message at the SMTP stage
spam.save_success: Rspamd spam policy verified and enabled.

autoresponder.title: Autoresponder
autoresponder.desc: Replies to the same sender only once within the chosen interval using Dovecot Sieve vacation; prevents mail loops.
autoresponder.interval_label: Reply interval for the same sender
autoresponder.body_placeholder: Message stating you're out of office…

filters.title: Mail Filters
filters.desc: Move to a folder, forward to another address, or discard when sender, recipient or subject matches.

limits.title: Send Limit & Spam Suspension
limits.desc: The number of recipients sent via SMTP AUTH is tracked. The account is automatically suspended if the threshold is exceeded; 0 is unlimited.
limits.suspended_notice: This account was automatically suspended on {{date}} for exceeding limits. You can reactivate it from the mailbox list.

webmail.title: Webmail
webmail.desc: Access your mailboxes from the browser. Sign in with the full e-mail address and the account password.
